title: UK resident: is there any legal venue for short-term (5-15 min) crypto prediction markets, ideally with an API?
author: shugakayne101
selftext:
I'm UK-based and researching short-horizon crypto Up/Down style markets. 

I checked out www.Kalshi.com's signup requirements and I seen that UK is not allowed.

1. Is there any platform that legitimately serves UK residents with short-expiry crypto outcome or binary markets, and ideally offers an API with order book data?

2. If you're UK-based and trade or automate prediction markets, what do you use, and have you had any trouble with account restrictions or withdrawals? Whats your workaround the UK restriction if any?

3. Is there anything properly regulated here (Gambling Commission-licensed or FCA-authorised) that does something similar, or is the honest answer "not yet"?

comments.author: so4d_st
comments.body: I guess a VPN can let you use kalshi and Polymarket

replies.body: Yea. Thats a good guess. But it wont be soo good when I have a sizeable chunk of profits I cannot cash out due to the system flagging my account for by passing....lol..vThanks for the tip....its at the top of my list to be honest, just waiting to hear others give their own tips...

replies.body: If I remember correctly, and if profits are that good, you can always go to Poland or Portugal, open a LLC, cash out and close it haha ;) best of luck! I’ll keep following the thread tho, maybe someone has better insights
